title: W1 reattributed idempotency to live-status scoping, but the webhooks.gleam module doc still names claim_webhook_event
detail: AC7 requires "the comments name the real idempotency mechanism". The inline comments were corrected, but the module-level doc still points at claim_webhook_event, which this diff stopped calling.
recommended_fix: Update the module doc to attribute idempotency to the find/mark live-status scoping (WHERE status IN ('queued','contact_initiated')), matching the inline W1 comments.

title: W1 left sql.claim_webhook_event + claim_webhook_event.sql with zero callers
detail: After W1, claim_webhook_event is dead code: nothing in server/src or server/test calls it. Squirrel will keep regenerating the function from the .sql file each run.
recommended_fix: Delete claim_webhook_event.sql and rerun Squirrel to drop the generated function, or restore a caller if the claim layer is still intended as dedup.
